All amounts owed to Agent hereunder are due within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Delinquent payments are subject to a late payment charge of one and one half percent (1.5%) per month commencing sixty (60) days from the invoice date.
findings.explanation: Payment is due in 30 days, but late fees do not accrue until 60 days after the invoice date. This creates an unpenalized 30-day grace period for late payments.
findings.suggested_change: Amend the clause so that late payment charges commence immediately upon the payment due date (30 days from the invoice date).

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to propose a quick adjustment: - Regarding the relevant clause where payment is due in thirty days while late fees do not accrue until sixty days, I propose amending the agreement so that late payment charges commence immediately upon the payment due date. Please let me know if this is acceptable. Best regards,
